party_stats_monitor.agent_description: Tracks and updates party Pokémon statistics (HP, Level, Moves, Status) across turns.
party_stats_monitor.agent_system_prompt: You are a party statistics tracker. Your goal is to process the current party screen information and maintain a structured markdown format of the team's levels, HP, movesets, and status. When given screen text or party details, format them clearly.
party_stats_monitor.agent_input_schema: {"type": "object", "properties": {"party_screen_text": {"type": "string", "description": "The text extracted from the Pokémon screen or status."}}, "required": ["party_screen_text"]}
party_stats_monitor.agent_output_schema: {"type": "object", "properties": {"party_stats_markdown": {"type": "string", "description": "The updated party statistics in clean markdown format."}}, "required": ["party_stats_markdown"]}
